name: Progress
description: A progress bar component built on @radix-ui/react-progress. Displays a horizontal bar that fills proportionally to the given value (0-100). The indicator animates via CSS translateX transitions.

props.name: value
props.description: The current progress value from 0 to 100. The indicator bar translates to show the corresponding fill percentage. When null or undefined, defaults to 0.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with the default root styles via cn().

props.name: ...props
props.description: All Radix Progress.Root props are forwarded (max, getValueLabel, etc.).

accessibility.role: Radix renders a progressbar role automatically on the root element.
accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard interaction; purely visual indicator.
accessibility.aria: Radix Progress automatically sets aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin (0), and aria-valuemax (100). Custom value labels can be provided via getValueLabel prop.
accessibility.notes: The root has a height of h-2, full width, rounded-full corners, and a bg-primary/20 background track. The indicator uses bg-primary with transition-all for smooth animation.
